verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins is a law firm. Its offerings are legal counsel plus content tools such as the LathamDrive resources, a document generator and the Book of Jargon glossary, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships a developer API, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so the exception for evidence of the capability does not apply.
